regulations.title: 中华人民共和国数据安全法
regulations.title_en: Data Security Law of the People's Republic of China
regulations.body: 为了规范数据处理活动，保障数据安全，保护个人、组织的合法权益，维护国家主权、安全和发展利益，制定本法。国家对个人信息保护、重要数据出境安全评估、数据处理者义务作出规定，建立数据分类分级保护制度，明确数据安全风险评估和跨境数据传输要求。

regulations.title: General Data Protection Regulation
regulations.body: Regulation on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data. Establishes rules on personal data protection, data processing, cross border data transfer, data breach notification, privacy rights, and information security obligations for data controllers and processors.

regulations.title: 中华人民共和国增值税法
regulations.title_en: Value Added Tax Law of the PRC
regulations.body: 为了规范增值税征收管理，制定本法。规定纳税义务人、税率、增值税抵扣、纳税申报、税收优惠政策、税务稽查程序。明确增值税税率结构、小规模纳税人标准、进项税额抵扣范围与转让定价相关税务处理。

regulations.title: 中华人民共和国证券法（修订）
regulations.body: 为了规范证券发行和交易行为，保护投资者合法权益，维护社会经济秩序和社会公共利益，制定本法。规定证券发行注册制、信息披露义务、上市公司收购、内幕交易禁止、证券监管、交易所自律管理、并购重组与招股说明书要求。

regulations.title: Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive
regulations.body: Directive on corporate sustainability reporting. Extends ESG disclosure, environmental, climate, carbon emission, greenhouse gas (GHG), net zero, and sustainability reporting obligations for large companies.

regulations.title: Fair Labor Standards Act
regulations.body: An Act to provide for the establishment of fair labor standards in employments engaged in commerce. Establishes minimum wage, overtime pay, working time, recordkeeping, and child labor standards for employees and workers in the United States.

regulations.title: Digital Markets Act
regulations.body: Regulation on contestable and fair markets in the digital sector. Targets antitrust, monopoly, platform economy, gatekeepers, abuse of dominant position, unfair competition, fair competition, and merger review for digital markets in the European Union.

regulations.title: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers
regulations.body: International Financial Reporting Standard on revenue recognition. Establishes accounting principles for revenue, financial statement disclosure, accounting policy, fair value, contract, performance obligation, and consolidated reporting requirements for enterprises.

regulations.title: 数据出境安全评估办法
regulations.title_en: Measures for Security Assessment of Outbound Data Transfer
regulations.body: 为了规范数据出境活动，保护个人信息权益和数据安全，制定本办法。规定数据处理者向境外提供数据的跨境数据传输安全评估、重要数据出境、个人信息出境、数据合规与信息安全审查要求。
regulations.agency: 国家互联网信息办公室

regulations.title: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
regulations.body: An Act to provide for reconciliation pursuant to titles II and V of the concurrent resolution on the budget for fiscal year 2018. Reform corporate income tax, reduce tax rate, modify deduction rules, change transfer pricing, international tax provisions, withholding tax, and tax treaty interactions.

regulations.title: 中华人民共和国反垄断法（修订）
regulations.body: 为了预防和制止垄断行为，保护市场公平竞争，提高经济运行效率，制定本法。规定垄断协议禁止、滥用市场支配地位、经营者集中申报与审查、价格垄断、平台经济反垄断、不正当竞争与公平竞争审查。

regulations.title: 企业会计准则——基本准则
regulations.title_en: Accounting Standard for Business Enterprises - Basic Standard
regulations.body: 为了规范企业会计确认、计量和报告行为，保证会计信息质量，制定本准则。规定财务报告目标、会计要素确认、公允价值计量、收入确认、金融工具、减值、租赁、合并报表、股份支付、会计政策与会计估计、信息披露要求。
